statement.essentials: The skin is lifted forward in the layer just outside the gland’s capsule.
statement.anatomy: The skin flap is raised in the plane immediately superficial to the parotid fascia (a facelift-like plane).

sources.locator: Operative procedure: incision and flap elevation

limitations: The protocol also says the flap may be raised a little deeper than a facelift plane, just outside the periparotid fascia, to make it thicker.
